title: Two closed sets covering a fibre spread to a covering
statement: Let g : P → T be a locally finite type, quasi-compact morphism of schemes. Let y ∈ T and let C and D be closed subsets of P. If g⁻¹({y}) ⊆ C ∪ D, there is an ambient open V ⊆ T containing y such that g⁻¹(V ∩ closure({y})) ⊆ C ∪ D.

source.place: Tag 054Y (Lemma 37.24.5), finite closed covering; Tag 055N, reduction to the reduced closure of a point

proof.text: Construct the reduced induced closed subscheme Z on closure({y}) by the vanishing ideal. Its closed immersion j has range closure({y}); the source-library reducedness instance and irreducibility of the closure of a singleton show Z is integral. The point eta over y specializes to every point of Z, by the embedding specialization equivalence.

Base change g along j to f. Finite type and quasi-compactness are stable under base change. Apply generic flatness to obtain a nonempty open U of Z such that f restricted to U is flat. The point eta belongs to U since it specializes to every point.

Use the induced topology of j to write U as the inverse image of an ambient open V of T. Then y belongs to V. A point x of P mapping into V intersected with closure({y}) lifts to the pullback by Scheme.Pullback.range_fst, with image in U.

Mathlib Flat.generalizingMap lifts the specialization from eta to the image of this lifted point along the flat restriction. Project the resulting generalization to P. It lies in the fibre over y and thus in C union D. Specialization preserves membership in the closed set C union D, proving the inclusion.

proof_origin.place: Tags 054Y, 052A and 03HV; reduced-closure reduction in Tag 055N
proof_origin.note: The compiled proof uses generic flatness and Mathlib generalization lifting directly instead of a separate finite closed-cover spreading theorem. The reduced closure, pullback and all topological glue are constructed and proved in Lean.

theorem exists_open_generic_fibre_closed_cover {P T : Scheme.{u}} (g : P ⟶ T)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g] (y : T) (C D : Set P)
    (hC : IsClosed C) (hD : IsClosed D) (hcover : g ⁻¹' {y} ⊆ C ∪ D) :
    ∃ V : Set T, IsOpen V ∧ y ∈ V ∧ g ⁻¹' (V ∩ closure {y}) ⊆ C ∪ D
